caption: The drawing depicts a circular object with a border composed of evenly spaced, radiating brown lines. Inside the circle, there is a central image of a beehive, rendered in brown, sitting on a horizontal base. Surrounding the beehive are two branches with elongated leaves, one curving from the bottom left and the other from the bottom right toward the top, meeting near the top center but not touching. There are three small, brown dots arranged in a triangular pattern above the beehive and between the leaves, and faint brown botanical or decorative forms appear around the beehive. The background within the circle is shaded with muted tones of brown and light gray. Below and to the right of the circle, the name CHARLOTTE ANGUS is printed in black, capital letters on the beige or off-white paper background.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
